definition_zh: 飞；飞翔；乘飞机；驾驶飞机；飞逝
definition_en: to move through the air, travel by plane, pilot an aircraft, wave in the wind, or pass quickly
core_image: 一只鸟张开翅膀，越过湖面飞向远处的树林
scene: 鸟飞过湖面。A bird flew over the lake.
sceneCN: 这里 fly 是「飞」（第 1 个义项）；句意：鸟飞过湖面。

senses.title: Move through air
senses.definition: to move through the air with wings or power
senses.definitionCN: 靠翅膀或动力在空中移动
senses.example: A bird flew over the lake.
senses.why: This is the basic physical sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是最基本的物理义项。

senses.title: Travel by plane
senses.definition: to travel in an aircraft
senses.example: We will fly to Beijing tomorrow.
senses.exampleCN: 我们明天乘飞机去北京。
senses.why: People fly as passengers too.
senses.whyCN: 人也能作为乘客飞行。

senses.title: Pilot
senses.definition: to control an aircraft in flight
senses.example: She flies a small plane.
senses.why: The verb can name the pilot's action.
senses.whyCN: 这个动词也可指飞行员的操作。

senses.title: Wave in air
senses.definition: to move freely in the wind
senses.example: Flags fly above the square.
senses.why: Cloth moves through air like a wing.
senses.whyCN: 布像翅膀一样在空中移动。

senses.title: Pass quickly
senses.definition: to pass very quickly
senses.example: The summer flew by.
senses.why: Time is imagined as flying.
senses.whyCN: 时间被想象成在飞。

intro.en: Fly comes from an Old English word for moving through the air.
intro.cn: fly 来自古英语中表示在空中移动的词。

items.en: Fleogan meant to fly with wings.
items.cn: fleogan 意为用翅膀飞行。

items.en: Fleuganan carried the same airy sense.
items.cn: fleuganan 带有同样的空中含义。

items.en: Fly extended to travel by aircraft.
items.cn: fly 扩展到乘飞机旅行。

items.en: Fly described flags and hair moving in wind.
items.cn: fly 形容旗帜和头发在风中飘动。

items.en: Time flies became a common saying.
items.cn: time flies 成为常用俗语。

note.en: Fly is compared with similar-looking words and with words for air travel.
note.cn: 把 fly 与形近词以及表示空中飞行的词作比较。

entries.definition: to fly high in the air
to go from one place to another

normalIntro.en: Fly is a bird, a passenger, a pilot, a flag, and time itself moving through air.
normalIntro.cn: fly 可以是鸟、乘客、飞行员、旗帜，也可以是穿过空气的时间。

normal.en: Birds fly south in winter.
We fly to Shanghai on Monday.
normal.cn: 我们周一乘飞机去上海。

normal.en: He flies a helicopter.
The flag flies in the wind.
Time flies when you are busy.

abstract.en: A plane is a metal bird with a schedule.
abstract.cn: 飞机是一只有时刻表的金属鸟。

abstract.en: Flags fly because they are tied down.
abstract.cn: 旗帜能飘扬是因为它被系住了。

abstract.en: Time flies only when we look back.
abstract.cn: 只有回头看时，时间才显得飞快。

examples.en: A bird flew over the lake.
We will fly to Beijing tomorrow.
examples.cn: 我们明天乘飞机去北京。

examples.en: The summer flew by.

dict_mnemonic.text: fly 的核心是「离地而行」：鸟飞、人坐飞机飞、旗子被风带着飞、时间也飞。

root: 源自古英语 fleogan（用翅膀飞行），核心义「在空中移动」。

sensesIntro.en: Fly means to move through air, travel by plane, pilot a plane, wave in wind, or pass quickly.
sensesIntro.cn: fly 意为飞、乘飞机、驾驶飞机、飘动或飞逝。

core.en: Leaving the ground and moving through air.
core.cn: 离开地面并在空中移动。

branches.en: A bird beats its wings and rises.
A passenger boards a plane.
A pilot controls the aircraft.
Cloth waves in the wind.
Time seems to pass on wings.

intro.en: Fly forms a family of flight and travel words.
intro.cn: fly 形成一个表示飞行与旅行的词族。

latinIntro.en: Fly has no Latin ancestor; Latin volare, to fly, is only a semantic parallel.
latinIntro.cn: fly 没有拉丁语来源；拉丁语 volare（飞）只是语义对应词。

items.example: The eagle flies above the valley.
She flies every week for work.
They flew to Tokyo last night.
He has flown this route for years.
Flying fish leap from the water.

items.meaning: a pilot or a printed sheet

definition_zh: 焦点；聚焦；集中；重点
definition_en: the point where light or attention meets, or to direct attention or a lens there
core_image: 放大镜把阳光聚成一点，纸面冒起一缕烟
scene: 请把注意力集中在题目上。Please focus on the question.
sceneCN: 这里 focus 是「集中」（第 2 个义项）；句意：请把注意力集中在题目上。

senses.title: Point of light
senses.definition: the point where rays of light meet
senses.example: Adjust the lens until the image is in focus.
senses.exampleCN: 调节镜头直到图像清晰对焦。
senses.why: This is the original optical sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是最初的光学义项。

senses.title: To concentrate
senses.definition: to direct attention toward something
senses.example: Please focus on the question.
senses.exampleCN: 请把注意力集中在题目上。
senses.why: Attention is treated like a beam of light.
senses.whyCN: 注意力被当作一束光。

senses.title: To adjust a lens
senses.definition: to make an image clear by moving a lens
senses.example: She focused the camera on the bird.
senses.exampleCN: 她把相机对准鸟儿对焦。
senses.why: The verb keeps the optical action.
senses.whyCN: 动词保留了光学的动作。

senses.title: Main point
senses.definition: the central subject of attention
senses.example: Cost is the main focus of the report.
senses.exampleCN: 成本是这份报告的重点。
senses.why: The meeting point of rays becomes a topic.
senses.whyCN: 光线的汇聚点引申为话题。

intro.en: Focus is Latin for hearth, the fireplace at the centre of a home.
intro.cn: focus 在拉丁语中意为壁炉，即家宅中央的火塘。

items.en: Focus meant a hearth or fireplace.
items.cn: focus 意为壁炉或火塘。

items.en: Opticians used focus for the point of rays.
items.cn: 光学家用 focus 表示光线的汇聚点。

items.en: Focus entered English as an optical term.
items.cn: focus 作为光学术语进入英语。

items.en: Focus extended to attention and importance.
items.cn: focus 扩展到注意力与重要性。

items.en: Focus became a common verb meaning concentrate.
items.cn: focus 成为表示集中的常用动词。

note.en: Focus is compared with similar-looking words and with words for attention and centres.
note.cn: 把 focus 与形近词以及表示注意力和中心的词作比较。

entries.definition: trickery, used in the phrase hocus-pocus
the act of watching or listening carefully

normalIntro.en: Focus is a meeting point: light, attention, or the main topic all gather there.
normalIntro.cn: focus 是一个汇聚点：光、注意力或主要话题都在那里聚集。

normal.en: Focus on your homework.
The camera is in focus.
The main focus is safety.
He lost focus during the lecture.
Focus the light on the paper.

abstract.en: Attention is a beam you can point.
abstract.cn: 注意力是一束可以指向的光。

abstract.en: A clear focus leaves the rest blurred.
abstract.cn: 清晰的焦点让其余部分变模糊。

abstract.en: A hearth and a lens both gather people and light.
abstract.cn: 火塘聚人，镜头聚光。

examples.en: Please focus on the question.
examples.cn: 请把注意力集中在题目上。

examples.en: She focused the camera on the bird.
examples.cn: 她把相机对准鸟儿对焦。

examples.en: Cost is the main focus of the report.
examples.cn: 成本是这份报告的重点。

dict_mnemonic.text: focus 原指家中火塘，是一家人目光汇聚之处；后来指光线汇聚的焦点，再指注意力的集中点。

root: 源自拉丁语 focus（火塘、壁炉），核心义「汇聚的中心点」。

sensesIntro.en: Focus means an optical point, to concentrate, to adjust a lens, or the main point.
sensesIntro.cn: focus 意为焦点、集中、对焦或重点。

core.en: A point where rays or attention come together.
core.cn: 光线或注意力汇聚的一点。

branches.en: Light rays meet at one point.
The mind gathers on one task.
branches.cn: 心思聚集在一项任务上。

branches.en: The lens is moved until clear.
A report centres on one subject.
Light and attention follow the same geometry.
branches.cn: 光与注意力遵循同样的几何。

intro.en: Focus forms a family of attention and lens words.
intro.cn: focus 形成一个表示注意力与镜头的词族。

latinIntro.en: Focus is a Latin word for hearth; it has no productive Latin affixes.
latinIntro.cn: focus 是拉丁语中表示火塘的词；它在拉丁语中没有能产后缀。

items.exampleCN: 她给出了重点明确的回答。

items.example: Let us refocus on the plan.

items.meaning: a camera system that focuses itself
items.exampleCN: 这部手机自动对焦很快。

definition_zh: 折叠；合拢；交叠；倒闭；羊圈
definition_en: to bend something over on itself, to close, to fail as a business, or a pen for sheep
core_image: 双手把一张信纸对折，压出整齐的折痕
scene: 她把信折好放进信封。She folded the letter and put it in the envelope.
sceneCN: 这里 fold 是「折叠」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她把信折好放进信封。

senses.title: Bend over
senses.definition: to bend something so that one part lies on another
senses.definitionCN: 弯曲某物使一部分叠在另一部分上
senses.example: She folded the letter and put it in the envelope.
senses.why: This is the basic physical sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是最基本的物理义项。

senses.title: Cross arms
senses.definition: to cross one's arms or hands
senses.example: He folded his arms and waited.
senses.why: Body parts fold like paper.
senses.whyCN: 身体部位像纸一样折叠。

senses.title: Close down
senses.definition: to close a business after failure
senses.example: The shop folded after a year.
senses.exampleCN: 那家店一年后就倒闭了。
senses.why: A failing business closes like a folded chair.
senses.whyCN: 失败的企业像折起的椅子一样合上。

senses.title: Sheep pen
senses.definition: an enclosed area where sheep are kept
senses.example: The farmer led the sheep into the fold.
senses.why: This old noun sense has its own origin.
senses.whyCN: 这个古老的名词义项另有来源。

intro.en: The verb fold comes from Old English fealdan; the sheep pen fold comes from a different Old English word.
intro.cn: 动词 fold 来自古英语 fealdan；羊圈义的 fold 来自另一个古英语词。

items.en: Fealdan meant to bend or wrap.
items.cn: fealdan 意为弯曲或包裹。

items.en: Fald meant a pen for sheep.
items.cn: fald 意为圈羊的围栏。

items.en: Folden kept the sense of bending cloth and paper.
items.cn: folden 保留了折布折纸的含义。

items.en: Fold described closing a business.
items.cn: fold 开始形容企业关闭。

items.en: Fold became common in computing and design.
items.cn: fold 在计算机与设计领域变得常见。

note.en: Fold is compared with similar-looking words and with words for bending and closing.
note.cn: 把 fold 与形近词以及表示弯曲和关闭的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: To fold is to make one surface meet another and leave a line behind.
normalIntro.cn: fold 就是让两个面相遇，并留下一条折痕。

normal.en: Fold the paper in half.
He folded his arms.
Fold up the chair after use.
The business folded last year.
The sheep slept in the fold.

abstract.en: A folded map hides more than it shows.
abstract.cn: 折起的地图藏起的比显示的多。

abstract.en: Some businesses fold like paper chairs.
abstract.cn: 有些企业像纸椅一样折倒。

abstract.en: A crease remembers every fold.
abstract.cn: 折痕记得每一次折叠。

examples.en: She folded the letter and put it in the envelope.
He folded his arms and waited.
The shop folded after a year.
examples.cn: 那家店一年后就倒闭了。

dict_mnemonic.text: fold 的核心是「一面向另一面靠拢」：折纸、抱臂、关店，都是合起来。

root: 动词源自古英语 fealdan（弯曲、包裹）；羊圈义源自古英语 fald。

sensesIntro.en: Fold means to bend over, cross the arms, close a business, or a sheep pen.
sensesIntro.cn: fold 意为折叠、交叠、倒闭或羊圈。

core.en: One surface laid over another.
core.cn: 一个面叠在另一个面上。

branches.en: Paper bent into two layers.
Arms crossed over the chest.
A business closing its doors.
A pen that holds sheep together.
Paper folds and businesses fold, both closing up.
branches.cn: 纸会折，企业会倒，都是合拢。

intro.en: Fold forms a family of bending and closing words.
intro.cn: fold 形成一个表示弯曲与合拢的词族。

latinIntro.en: Fold has no Latin ancestor; Latin plicare, to fold, is only a semantic parallel.
latinIntro.cn: fold 没有拉丁语来源；拉丁语 plicare（折叠）只是语义对应词。

items.example: The napkin was folded into a swan.
Put the report in the folder.
The phone has a foldable screen.
items.exampleCN: 这部手机有可折叠屏幕。

items.example: Unfold the map on the table.

definition_zh: 人们；民间的；民谣；家人
definition_en: ordinary people, their traditional culture, folk music, or one's family
core_image: 村口的老人们围坐一起，弹着旧吉他唱起世代相传的歌
scene: 这些歌是世代相传的民间音乐。These songs are traditional folk music.
sceneCN: 这里 folk 是「民间的」（第 2 个义项）；句意：这些歌是世代相传的民间音乐。

senses.title: Ordinary people
senses.definition: ordinary people, especially of a region
senses.definitionCN: 普通人，尤指某一地区的人
senses.example: Local folk gathered in the square.
senses.exampleCN: 当地人们聚集在广场上。
senses.why: This is the oldest general sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的泛指义项。

senses.title: Traditional
senses.definition: belonging to the traditional culture of ordinary people
senses.definitionCN: 属于普通人传统文化的
senses.example: These songs are traditional folk music.
senses.exampleCN: 这些歌是世代相传的民间音乐。
senses.why: The people's culture is called folk culture.
senses.whyCN: 人民的文化被称为民间文化。

senses.title: Folk music
senses.definition: music in the traditional style of a community
senses.definitionCN: 一个群体传统风格的音乐
senses.example: She plays folk at the café.
senses.why: The adjective shortens into a noun for the genre.
senses.whyCN: 形容词缩短为该流派的名称。

senses.title: Family
senses.definition: one's family or relatives, in informal use
senses.definitionCN: 非正式用法中指家人或亲戚
senses.example: I am visiting my folks this weekend.
senses.exampleCN: 这周末我要去看望家人。
senses.why: The plural folks often means family.
senses.whyCN: 复数 folks 常指家人。

intro.en: Folk comes from an Old English word for a people or nation.
intro.cn: folk 来自古英语中表示民族或人群的词。

items.en: Folc meant people or a nation.
items.cn: folc 意为人民或民族。

items.en: Fulkam carried the same group sense.
items.cn: fulkam 带有同样的群体含义。

items.en: Folk named common people and their customs.
items.cn: folk 指普通民众及其习俗。

items.en: Folk music and folklore named traditions.
items.cn: folk music 与 folklore 命名传统。

items.en: Folks became an informal word for family.
items.cn: folks 成为表示家人的非正式词。

note.en: Folk is compared with similar-looking words and with words for people and tradition.
note.cn: 把 folk 与形近词以及表示人和传统的词作比较。

entries.definition: a tool with prongs for eating
the yellow part of an egg
a custom passed down over time
a group living in one place

normalIntro.en: Folk is the people and everything they pass down by voice.
normalIntro.cn: folk 是人民，以及他们口口相传的一切。

normal.en: Folk songs tell old stories.
Local folk know the river well.
normal.cn: 当地人对这条河很熟悉。

normal.en: She studies folk art.
Old folk need a place to sit.
My folks live in the country.

abstract.en: Folk memory keeps what history forgets.
abstract.cn: 民间记忆保存了历史遗忘的东西。

abstract.en: A song belongs to everyone who sings it.
abstract.cn: 一首歌属于每个唱它的人。

abstract.en: Folk culture has no single author.
abstract.cn: 民间文化没有唯一的作者。

examples.en: These songs are traditional folk music.
examples.cn: 这些歌是世代相传的民间音乐。

examples.en: Local folk gathered in the square.
examples.cn: 当地人们聚集在广场上。

examples.en: I am visiting my folks this weekend.
examples.cn: 这周末我要去看望家人。

dict_mnemonic.text: folk 就是「老百姓」：老百姓的歌是民谣，老百姓的传说就是民俗，口语里也指自家人。

root: 源自古英语 folc（人民、民族），核心义「普通人群及其传统」。

sensesIntro.en: Folk means ordinary people, traditional culture, folk music, or one's family.
sensesIntro.cn: folk 意为人们、民间的、民谣或家人。

core.en: Ordinary people and what they hand down.
core.cn: 普通人以及他们传承下来的东西。

branches.en: Neighbours gathered in the square.
Culture passed down by ordinary people.
Songs with no single author.
Family in everyday speech.
The same word widens from a people to a family.
branches.cn: 同一个词从一群人民缩到一家人。

intro.en: Folk forms a family of tradition and community words.
intro.cn: folk 形成一个表示传统与社群的词族。

latinIntro.en: Folk has no Latin ancestor; Latin populus, people, is only a semantic parallel.
latinIntro.cn: folk 没有拉丁语来源；拉丁语 populus（人民）只是语义对应词。

items.example: The tale is part of local folklore.
items.exampleCN: 这个故事是当地民俗的一部分。

items.example: The shop has a folksy charm.
items.exampleCN: 这家店有一种朴实的魅力。

items.example: They sang a folk song together.
items.exampleCN: 他们一起唱了一首民歌。

items.example: Every village has its own folk tale.
items.exampleCN: 每个村庄都有自己的民间故事。

items.example: The children learned a folk dance.
items.exampleCN: 孩子们学了一支民间舞。
博物馆展出了民间艺术。

definition_zh: 跟随；遵循；听懂；关注；接着发生
definition_en: to go after someone, obey rules, understand, keep track of, or happen as a result
core_image: 一个人沿着前人留在雪地里的脚印一步步向前走
scene: 小狗一路跟着我回家。The dog followed me home.
sceneCN: 这里 follow 是「跟随」（第 1 个义项）；句意：小狗一路跟着我回家。

senses.title: Go after
senses.definition: to go along behind someone or something
senses.definitionCN: 跟在某人或某物的后面走
senses.example: The dog followed me home.
senses.why: This is the basic physical sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是最基本的物理义项。

senses.title: Obey
senses.definition: to act according to a rule or instruction
senses.example: All drivers must follow the rules.
senses.exampleCN: 所有司机都必须遵守规则。
senses.why: Following a path becomes following a rule.
senses.whyCN: 跟随路径引申为遵循规则。

senses.title: Understand
senses.definition: to understand an explanation or story
senses.example: I could not follow his argument.
senses.why: The mind follows a line of thought.
senses.whyCN: 头脑跟随思路走。

senses.title: Keep track of
senses.definition: to watch or keep up with someone or something
senses.definitionCN: 注视或持续了解某人某物
senses.example: She follows the news every morning.
senses.why: Attention follows a subject over time.
senses.whyCN: 注意力随时间跟随一个主题。

senses.title: Result
senses.definition: to happen as a result of something
senses.definitionCN: 作为某事物的结果而发生
senses.example: It follows that the plan will work.
senses.exampleCN: 由此可见这个计划会奏效。
senses.why: One event follows another in logic.
senses.whyCN: 在逻辑中一个事件接着另一个。

intro.en: Follow comes from an Old English word meaning to go after.
intro.cn: follow 来自古英语中表示「跟在后面走」的词。

items.en: Folgian meant to go after or serve.
items.cn: folgian 意为跟随或侍奉。

items.en: Fulgon carried the same sense of pursuit.
items.cn: fulgon 带有同样的追随含义。

items.en: Follower described a servant or disciple.
items.cn: follower 指仆从或门徒。

items.en: Follow extended to rules and explanations.
items.cn: follow 扩展到规则与解释。

items.en: Social media gave follow a new meaning.
items.cn: 社交媒体赋予 follow 新含义。

note.en: Follow is compared with similar-looking words and with words for chasing and obeying.
note.cn: 把 follow 与形近词以及表示追赶和服从的词作比较。

entries.definition: to do what you are told

normalIntro.en: Follow is to keep behind something: a person, a rule, a story, or a line of thought.
normalIntro.cn: follow 就是跟在某物后面：人、规则、故事或思路。

normal.en: Follow me, please.
Follow the safety rules.
I could not follow the film.
She follows three news sites.
The results follow the data.

abstract.en: To follow is to trust the path someone else made.
abstract.cn: 跟随就是信任别人走过的路。

abstract.en: Rules follow people long after they are written.
abstract.cn: 规则写下来后仍长期跟着人。

abstract.en: A story moves only when you follow it.
abstract.cn: 故事只有被你跟随时才向前走。

examples.en: The dog followed me home.
All drivers must follow the rules.

examples.en: I waited for them at the foot of the hill.

The king forgave the prisoner.
It is hard to forgive a lie.

core.en: Letting go of a claim against someone.
core.cn: 放弃对某人的追讨。

branches.en: The anger is put down.
A serious wrong is pardoned.
A debt is crossed out.

branches.cn: 私人怒气与公开赦免共享同一种释放。

intro.en: Forgive builds a family of pardon and patience words.

latinIntro.en: Forgive is Germanic; Latin ignoscere, to pardon, is only a semantic parallel.

definition_zh: 叉子；岔口；用叉叉起；分叉
definition_en: a tool with prongs for eating, a place where a road divides, to lift with a fork, or to divide into branches

scene: 桌上有一把银叉。There is a silver fork on the table.

senses.title: An eating tool

senses.why: This is the most familiar sense.

senses.title: A divided road

senses.example: Turn left at the fork.

senses.title: To lift with a fork

senses.why: The noun turns into an action.

senses.title: To divide
senses.definition: to divide into two or more branches

note.en: Fork is compared with similar-looking words and with words for utensils and branches.

Turn left at the fork.

normal.en: The river forks near the village.
Use a garden fork for the soil.

abstract.en: A fork is a small decision made of metal.

abstract.en: The same shape serves the table and the map.
abstract.cn: 同一种形状同时服务于餐桌和地图。

examples.en: There is a silver fork on the table.
Turn left at the fork.
The river forks near the village.

core.en: One handle splitting into several points.
core.cn: 一个手柄分成几个尖点。

branches.en: The prongs lift the food.
The road splits in two.
The hand uses the tool.

Roads and rivers both fork.

intro.cn: fork 构成表示进食与分叉的词族。

definition_zh: 形式；表格；形状；形成
definition_en: a shape or type, a printed document with spaces to fill in, or to make something
core_image: 黏土在手中被慢慢捏成一个圆润的碗形
scene: 请填好这张表格。Please fill in this form.
sceneCN: 这里 form 是「表格」（第 2 个义项）；句意：请填好这张表格。

senses.title: A type or kind
senses.definition: a particular type or way of doing something
senses.definitionCN: 某种特定类型或做事方式
senses.example: Music is a form of language.
senses.why: This is the abstract everyday sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是日常的抽象义项。

senses.title: A document
senses.definition: a printed paper with spaces to write answers
senses.definitionCN: 印有空格供填写答案的纸
senses.example: Please fill in this form.
senses.why: Blank spaces give the page its shape.
senses.whyCN: 空白格赋予页面固定形状。

senses.title: A shape
senses.definition: the shape or outline of something
senses.example: The cloud took the form of a horse.
senses.exampleCN: 那朵云变成了马的形状。
senses.why: This is the oldest visual sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的视觉义项。

senses.title: To make
senses.definition: to make or develop something
senses.example: They formed a new team.
senses.exampleCN: 他们组成了一个新团队。
senses.why: The noun turns into the act of giving shape.
senses.whyCN: 名词转化为赋予形状的动作。

intro.en: Form comes from a Latin word for shape or mold.
intro.cn: form 来自拉丁语中表示形状或模子的词。

items.en: Forma meant shape, mold, or beauty.
items.cn: forma 意为形状、模子或美。

items.en: Forme carried the sense of shape.
items.cn: forme 保留了形状的含义。

items.en: Form named shape and outward appearance.
items.cn: form 指形状与外观。

items.en: Printed forms gave the word its paper sense.
items.cn: 印刷表格赋予这个词纸质文件的义项。

items.en: The verb came to mean to make or organize.
items.cn: 动词义发展为制造或组织。

note.en: Form is compared with similar-looking words and with words for shape and type.
note.cn: 把 form 与形近词以及表示形状和类型的词作比较。

entries.definition: a kind of person or thing
a paper or file with information

normalIntro.en: Form is the shape something takes, on clay or on paper.
normalIntro.cn: form 是事物呈现的形状，无论在黏土上还是在纸上。

normal.en: Music is a form of language.
Please fill in this form.
The cloud took the form of a horse.
normal.cn: 那朵云变成了马的形状。

normal.en: They formed a new team.
normal.cn: 他们组成了一个新团队。

normal.en: Water can take the form of ice.

abstract.en: Every form is a decision about what to show.
abstract.cn: 每种形式都是关于展示什么的一次决定。

abstract.en: A blank form is a question waiting for an answer.
abstract.cn: 空白表格是等待答案的问题。

abstract.en: Shape and meaning grow together.
abstract.cn: 形状与意义一同生长。

examples.en: Please fill in this form.

examples.cn: 那朵云变成了马的形状。

dict_mnemonic.text: form 的核心是「给东西一个样子」：泥有样子是形状，纸有格子是表格，人有样子就被组织起来。

root: 源自拉丁语 forma（形状、模子），核心义「事物呈现出的样子」。

sensesIntro.en: Form means a type, a printed document, a shape, or to make something.
sensesIntro.cn: form 意为形式、表格、形状或形成。

core.en: A shape that something takes or is given.
core.cn: 事物呈现或被赋予的形状。

branches.en: A type is a shared pattern.
Lines on paper hold answers.
The outline is what the eye sees.
Hands give material a shape.
Shape seen and shape made are one idea.
branches.cn: 看见的形状与做出的形状是同一个概念。

intro.en: Form builds one of the largest families in English.
intro.cn: form 构成英语中最大的词族之一。

latinIntro.en: Form comes from Latin forma; the Latin entry below shows that source.
latinIntro.cn: form 来自拉丁语 forma；下面的拉丁条目展示了这一来源。

items.example: The form of the vase is simple.
items.exampleCN: 这个花瓶的形状很简单。

The formation of ice takes time.
The law aims to reform the system.
items.exampleCN: 这项法律旨在改革该制度。

latinEntries.example: Forma is the Latin source of form.
latinEntries.exampleCN: forma 是 form 的拉丁语来源。

definition_zh: 正式的；正规的；拘谨的；形式上的
definition_en: following official rules, suitable for serious occasions, stiff in manner, or concerned with outward form
core_image: 熨得笔挺的西装，领带打得一丝不苟
scene: 他穿正装参加正式晚宴。He wore a suit to the formal dinner.
sceneCN: 这里 formal 是「正式的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：他穿正装参加正式晚宴。

senses.title: Official
senses.definition: following official rules or suitable for serious occasions
senses.definitionCN: 遵循官方规则或适合严肃场合
senses.example: He wore a suit to the formal dinner.
senses.exampleCN: 他穿正装参加正式晚宴。
senses.why: This is the central social sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是核心的社交义项。

senses.title: Organized education
senses.definition: following a planned system, as in education
senses.definitionCN: 遵循有计划体系的，如教育
senses.example: She had no formal education.
senses.why: Rules and systems extend beyond ceremonies.
senses.whyCN: 规则与体系不只存在于仪式中。

senses.title: Stiff in manner
senses.definition: polite in a stiff and distant way
senses.example: His formal manner made us uneasy.
senses.exampleCN: 他拘谨的举止让我们不自在。
senses.why: Formality can become coldness.
senses.whyCN: 正式可以变成冷淡。

senses.title: Of outward form
senses.definition: concerned with form rather than content
senses.example: The objection was merely formal.
senses.exampleCN: 这个反对只是形式上的。
senses.why: Logic and law distinguish form from substance.
senses.whyCN: 逻辑与法律区分形式与实质。

items.en: Formalis meant of form or shape.

abstract.en: Rules give shape to respect.

senses.title: According to form

senses.definitionCN: 从外在形式而非内容来看

items.cn: 军事用途赋予它排列成队的义项。

items.en: Geology borrowed it for layers of rock.
items.cn: 地质学借用它表示岩层。

note.en: Formation is compared with similar-looking words and with words for creating and arranging.
note.cn: 把 formation 与形近词以及表示创造和排列的词作比较。

entries.definition: the act of making something new
the order in which things are placed
the way parts are put together

normalIntro.en: Formation is the moment pieces decide to become a whole.
normalIntro.cn: formation 是各个部分决定成为一个整体的时刻。

normal.en: The formation of clouds needs vapor and cold air.
normal.cn: 云的形成需要水汽和冷空气。

normal.en: The planes flew in formation.
The cliff shows a rock formation.
The formation of the club took a year.
normal.cn: 俱乐部的组建花了一年。

normal.en: Team formation starts with trust.

abstract.en: Every formation begins with a first piece.
abstract.cn: 每一种形成都从第一个部分开始。

abstract.en: Order appears when parts agree to meet.
abstract.cn: 当部分同意相遇，秩序就出现了。

abstract.en: Rock remembers the shape of old time.
abstract.cn: 岩石记住古老时间的形状。

examples.en: The formation of clouds needs vapor and cold air.
examples.cn: 云的形成需要水汽和冷空气。

examples.en: The planes flew in formation.
The cliff shows a rock formation.

dict_mnemonic.text: formation 是 form 的名词形式：把东西造出来是形成，把人排起来是编队，把岁月压起来是地层。

root: 源自拉丁语 formatio（塑造），核心义「把部分组织成整体的过程或结果」。

sensesIntro.en: Formation means the process of forming, an arranged group, a rock layer, or a created body.
sensesIntro.cn: formation 意为形成、编队、地层或组成。

core.en: Parts joining into a recognizable whole.
core.cn: 各部分结合成可辨认的整体。

branches.en: Clouds gather and become visible.
Planes hold a pattern in the sky.
Stone records a layer of time.
branches.cn: 石头记录一段时间的地层。

branches.en: A club comes into being.
Nature and people both form groups.
branches.cn: 自然与人都会形成团体。

intro.en: Formation sits inside the large family built on form.
intro.cn: formation 位于由 form 构成的庞大词族之中。

latinIntro.en: Formation comes from Latin formatio; the Latin entry below shows that source.
latinIntro.cn: formation 来自拉丁语 formatio；下面的拉丁条目展示了这一来源。

items.exampleCN: 岩石呈现出奇特的形态。

items.meaning: facts that give form to knowledge

latinEntries.example: Formatio is the Latin source of formation.
latinEntries.exampleCN: formatio 是 formation 的拉丁语来源。
